Name: Warthog Wars
Overview:
Grab your friends to play against each other in Multiplayer, a battle to the death.

Endure on your own and battle against increasing forces wave after wave in Survival!

In campaign, complete objectives to save a treasured AI and destroy a beacon to let your friendly armada attack a fort under a bubble shield.

Upgrade your warthog in the store, making it have more speed, health, and weapons.
